title: FilteredComplexPositivePages
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K^\bullet$ a cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration of $K^\bullet$ by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. There exists a cohomological spectral sequence $E$ [def-sp-spectral-sequence] starting at page $1$, with differentials of bidegree $(r,1-r)$, such that for all integers $p,q,r$ with $r\ge1$, the subobjects $B_r^{p,q}=F.\mathrm{complexBoundaries}(p,p+q,r)$ and $Z_r^{p,q}=F.\mathrm{complexCycles}(p,p+q,r)$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] satisfy $B_r^{p,q}\le Z_r^{p,q}$ and $E_r^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{coker}(B_r^{p,q}\hookrightarrow Z_r^{p,q})$. No finite-filtration hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For each positive r select the uniquely specified differential on the concrete quotient objects provided by lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential. Its page is a homological complex of shape (r,1-r). The objects are explicitly constructed cokernels, using the proved boundaries-in-cycles inclusion.

For every page and bidegree use lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-homology to obtain its homology isomorphism to the concrete quotient at r+1. Transport its target along r+1=rprime and assemble Mathlib SpectralSequence from these page complexes and isomorphisms.
For p,q,r use the proved boundaries-in-cycles inequality. The page object is definitionally its boundary-inclusion cokernel, so the requested page comparison is the identity isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_positive_spectralSequence
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence C 1,
      ∀ (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
        ∃ hBZ : F.complexBoundaries p (p + q) r ≤ F.complexCycles p (p + q) r,
          Nonempty ((E.page r).X (p, q) ≅ cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hBZ))
